{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/chainparams.cpp only to store hardcoded snapshot Merkle roots without altering the kernel API or boundary.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Kernel files are only edited to add configuration parameters for the snapshot feature."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not touch mempool data structures, policy, or acceptance rules.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR is focused on UTXO snapshot distribution and has no connection to the mempool."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the P2P label and adds network protocol messages, a new service bit (NODE_UTXO_SET), and chunk handling in src/net_processing.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Implements an in-band P2P distribution mechanism for AssumeUTXO snapshots to eliminate out-of-band centralized sourcing. While reviewers raise significant architectural and trust objections to introducing multi-gigabyte unvalidated snapshot transfers into the trustless protocol, enabling native P2P snapshot sharing represents a substantial strategic enhancement to initial node sync UX."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds the downloadutxoset RPC in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp merely to expose the underlying P2P download process.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "The RPC change is only a control trigger for the P2P subsystem rather than an evolution of RPC machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test changes consist of functional tests in test/functional/p2p_utxo_set_share.py and test framework message definitions specific to the new P2P protocol.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests specific to the P2P UTXO sharing protocol belong to the P2P category rather than general test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds contrib/utxo-tools/utxo_snapshot_merkle.py purely as a companion script to generate protocol Merkle trees.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "The auxiliary script under contrib strictly supports the P2P snapshot feature and does not constitute general tooling work."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches logging and init files minimally to register the new logging category and initialize the download manager.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Incidental wiring in node init and logging does not represent changes to shared utility infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/validation.cpp by only 1 line and delegates to existing AssumeUTXO snapshot activation rather than modifying consensus or chainstate logic.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Although reviewers express concern over AssumeUTXO complexity, the patch itself consumes existing validation activation pathways rather than substantively changing validation invariants."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
